sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, father of the prosecutrix/complainant lodged a missing person report at P.S. Gogawa, District Khargone by stating that he along with his minor daughter/prosecutrix and other family members were sleeping in their house, at about 8.30 a.m. when he woke up he found that prosecutrix was missing from home.
They tried to search her everywhere but could not found her.

During the investigation it has been gathered that present applicant abducted the prosecutrix and took her with him to Banswara (Rajasthan) and committed rape upon her several times within a period of two months.
Accordingly, offence has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 03/03/2022.
Earlier bail application of applicant was dismissed on merit but later on investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
Prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trial Court, who has turned hostile.
She has not stated anything against present applicant in respect of the aforesaid offence.
Applicant has suffered jail incarceration for more than 01 year and 01 month.
He is permanent resident of Khargone district and final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-1) has categorically stated before the trial Court that the present applicant has neither abducted nor committed rape upon her and final conclusion of the trial will also take sufficient long time.
In these circumstances, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
